data.limitation: Exact selected-cache-array equality; original NetCDF-to-cache coarsening is not independently revalidated.

artifacts.contour: First test case only, mid-z slice of speed; does not establish population-wide structure preservation.

fixed_sequence.scope: One fixed real training sequence, file 131 frames 0–8, stride-4 spatial sampling to 16³, width 24; 12 blocks retained. 50 updates. Evaluation disables stochastic depth. Not evidence of full-size convergence.
